messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm settling in right now,{01 00 00 05 00} so
I'm kind of busy at the
moment.
{07 14 00}Would you mind coming back
tomorrow, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? It's
just such a mess right now!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma sean end praegu sisse,{01 00 00 05 00}
nii et mul on praegu
pisut kiire.
{07 14 00}Kas sa tuleksid homme
tagasi, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? Praegu
on siin lihtsalt segadus!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}if you're talking about
a housewarming party,
tomorrow's good!
{07 0e 00}I'd better clean up my
place, STAT! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}kui sa räägid
soojapeost,
siis homme sobib!
{07 0e 00}Pean oma kodu
KOHE korda! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, {01 00 00 0a 00}I can only let you in
if you're willing to help me
straighten up, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Where are my manners?{01 00 00 05 00}
Must be the moving stress.
Please stop by tomorrow.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hei, {01 00 00 0a 00}ma saan sind sisse
lasta ainult siis, kui aitad
koristada, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Oi!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kus on mu kombed?{01 00 00 05 00}
Vist kolimisstress.
Astu palun homme läbi.

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}I'm sorry, I'm really super
busy right now, as you can
probably see.
{07 14 00}If you come back tomorrow,
I promise to give you the
grand tour, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Vabandust, mul on praegu
tõesti ülikiire, nagu sa
ilmselt näed.
{07 14 00}Kui tuled homme tagasi,
luban ma sulle korraldada
suure ringkäigu, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}No, don't look!{01 00 00 14 00} My place is a
terrible mess right now!{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh,
it's just horrible!
{07 06 00}Please don't tell anyone
about my dark secret,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ei, ära vaata!{01 00 00 14 00} Mu kodus on
praegu kohutav segadus!{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh,
see on lihtsalt jube!
{07 06 00}Palun ära räägi kellelegi
minu tumedast saladusest,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
